name: SFA NEXEL Co., Ltd.
summary: Creative & Innovative System Corporation specializes in the fabrication and supply of advanced machinery crucial for producing a range of cutting-edge technologies. Their product line supports the manufacturing of lithium-ion batteries for IT devices and electric vehicles, alongside equipment for fuel cells, solar cells, and various display applications. Key offerings encompass essential electrode production equipment, such as coaters, roll presses, slitters, and tape laminators. The company, established in 2002, maintains its primary operations in Daegu, South Korea.
